title: Perfect Cuboid
exact_target: Does any genuine rectangular box have integer lengths for all three edges, all three face diagonals and its space diagonal?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1456 (ALG-011). CC BY 4.0.

Aubrey D. N. J. de Grey, Philip Gibbs and Louie Helm, Novel Required Properties of, and Efficient Algorithms to Seek, Perfect Cuboids, arXiv:2401.06784v1 (2024), Section 1, definition of a perfect cuboid.
